title: Dither dissolve
summary: One shot breaks into an ordered dither, dot by dot, in a sweep across the frame; the edge lights in the accent and the next shot is under it.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: bLine
params.default: Brand videos, made by your coding agent.

params.name: cell
params.description: the dither's dot size, in pixels at 1080p

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add dither-dissolve --name my-dither-dissolve
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-dither-dissolve/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-dither-dissolve/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: a transition that only this brand has
between a statement and the name
